documents.text: Richard Wood (American football) Richard Marlon Wood (born May 31, 1953) is a former American football All-American linebacker who played for the New York Jets and Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He was the team captain and leading tackler of the Buccaneers' early teams, coached by John McKay. Wood played high school football for Thomas Jefferson High School in Elizabeth, New Jersey. Wood attended the University of Southern California as a student and football player.
